rules.cwe_name: Improper Access Control
rules.description: An access-control policy is missing or incorrectly enforced for a protected resource.

rules.cwe_name: Exposure of Resource to Wrong Sphere
rules.description: A protected resource crosses its intended trust or control boundary and becomes accessible to an unintended actor.

rules.cwe_name: Permissions, Privileges, and Access Controls
rules.description: Legacy access-control category for failures in permissions, privileges, or authorization enforcement.

rules.cwe_name: Improper Link Resolution Before File Access ('Link Following')
rules.description: File access follows a symlink, hardlink, or shortcut to an unintended resource.

rules.cwe_name: Object Model Violation: Just One of Equals and Hashcode Defined
rules.description: Defining a hash operation without defining equality may be a mistake.

rules.cwe_name: Incorrect Authorization
rules.description: An authorization check exists but evaluates access incorrectly.

rules.cwe_name: Improper Encoding or Escaping of Output
rules.description: Writing user input directly to a web page allows for a cross-site scripting vulnerability.

rules.cwe_name: Missing Release of Resource after Effective Lifetime
rules.description: Opening a file without ensuring that it is always closed may lead to data loss or resource leaks.

rules.cwe_name: Function Call With Incorrect Number of Arguments
rules.description: A string formatting operation, such as '"%s: %s, %s" % (a,b)', where the number of conversion specifiers in the format string differs from the number of values to be formatted will raise a TypeError.

rules.cwe_name: Improper Neutralization of CRLF Sequences ('CRLF Injection')
rules.description: Untrusted CR or LF characters are not neutralized before use in line-delimited protocol metadata.
